source.title: USGS Bathymetry, Offshore of Monterey, California
source.sampling: Nearest native cell at a 10 m local grid. Null preserves NoData. No smoothing, depth clamp or vertical offset.
source.localProjection: WGS84 lon/lat; Earth radius 6371008.8 m, cos(origin latitude); X east, Z south. pyproj transforms EPSG:4326 to EPSG:26910 before sampling.
